column2: Decomposition of the "Targets Lost" annotation in the ecliptic yield figure.
The plot annotates interesting_invisible/exp_stars, where a star is invisible if
it fails EITHER cut of the single mask at lifesim/ams/core/ams.py:393. Both cuts
act on stellar columns only, so the split needs no SNR evaluation.
Interesting here is Experiment_1 eligibility alone, which is what reproduces
the annotated 26.7 %; including Experiment_2 gives 4493 stars and 36.0 %.
